headline: Drizzle thins toward the hour.
body: Nineteen degrees holds under unbroken cloud. Southwest wind continues at twenty-one kilometres. Fine rain settles, then begins to lift as pressure rises.

pulses.value: drizzle easing, 19°C, wind 21 km/h SW, pressure rising
